summary.zh: 管理线索、商机与往来邮件

description.zh: 读取线索、联系人与商机，记录通话和邮件往来并更新跟进状态。适合销售跟进时快速取上下文。首次连接在浏览器登录 Close 授权。
description.en: Read leads, contacts, and opportunities, log calls and emails, and update follow-up status. Useful for keeping context while working a deal. Sign in to Close in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Close 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Close and authorize on first connect
